# Leonardo Costa de Sá — AI Transformation Specialist

> I redesign how work gets done with AI, and make sure teams adopt it.
> From the first conversation with leadership to daily use: I map the process, decide
> where AI earns its place, implement it and train the people who use it.

Site: https://leonardosa.pro
Contact: leonardo@leonardosa.pro
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/leonardocostadesa/
GitHub: https://github.com/leonardocostadesa
Location: Madrid, Spain · CET
Languages: English (fluent), French (fluent), Portuguese (native), Spanish (professional working)

## What I do

- Process discovery and redesign: mapping how work gets done and where AI fits
- AI adoption programs: training, opportunity mapping, AI-enabled delivery models
- Implementation with AI: document intelligence, multi-agent workflows, Copilot Studio and Power Platform
- Digital marketing and content strategy background

## Experience

- **MasterTech — Founder, AI Transformation** (Jul 2026 – present). I work with leadership
  and teams to understand the operation, redesign processes, implement AI where it adds
  value and train the people who use it. For a landscaping company, connected the
  commercial journey (landing page, WhatsApp, email and a custom CRM with invoicing):
  every lead is now captured, and the CEO estimates 70% less repetitive quotation and
  admin work.
- **KPMG Brazil — Tax Transformation** (May 2025 – May 2026). AI Solutions Consultant,
  promoted to AI Solutions Consultant (Mid-level) to lead solution delivery and adoption.
  Built the business plan, approvals and IT environment for a Legal document-analysis
  solution; lawyers validated 98% accuracy on a 10% sample of 50,000+ documents. Trained
  1,600+ professionals to use AI in their daily work. Helped turn the Tax Reform
  methodology into an AI-enabled delivery model (30–60% less effort on covered activities).
- **Revisa Master — Co-founder, AI & Business Transformation** (Dec 2023 – present,
  part-time). Academic review and consulting for graduate students. I lead how the
  business uses AI and technology. Turned the senior reviewer's criteria into a review
  service: a six-hour first review now takes about fifteen minutes. Built the funnels
  and landing pages behind ~90% revenue growth in one quarter.
- **Legislative Assembly of São Paulo — Content Strategy & Analytics** (Mar 2023 – Jul 2024).
  Data-driven digital content strategy for a public institution; grew the audience by
  27K followers in 12 months.
- **Garden São Paulo — Web and Operations Developer** (Dec 2021 – Mar 2023). Built the
  company's first website, digital presence, CRM integrations and automation of
  commercial and administrative work, supporting 120%+ revenue growth in the period.
- **SFC Consultoria — Digital Communication Strategist** (Feb 2020 – Oct 2020). Copy and
  content strategy for info-product launches.

## Selected case studies (each has a dedicated page)

- **Tax Reform Delivery Model**: redesigned KPMG's delivery model into six phases with
  AI agents embedded where information piled up. Tax Transformation leadership presented
  30–60% efficiency gains on covered activities.
  https://leonardosa.pro/solutions/tax-reform-delivery-model
- **Document Analysis Automation** (Python, Power Automate, AI Builder, Azure Document
  Intelligence): a pipeline that analyzed every page of 50,000+ documents (1958–present,
  handwritten to born-digital) for an $8 billion lawsuit. 98% accuracy, validated by
  KPMG lawyers on a 10% sample. Three AI tools had failed before it. I also built the
  business plan, secured approval from partners and Legal, and negotiated the IT
  environment. Its output became key evidence in the case.
  https://leonardosa.pro/solutions/document-analysis-automation
- **AI Training for ALL**: trained 1,600+ tax professionals through real business
  problems, hybrid exercises and quarterly themes. 8,000 aggregate participant hours.
  https://leonardosa.pro/solutions/ai-training-for-all
- **Revisa Express** (Python, Django, CrewAI, pgvector): turned an expert reviewer's
  criteria into an 8-agent review service. A structured first review takes ~13.7
  minutes and costs ~$1.78, with expert review still in the loop.
  https://leonardosa.pro/solutions/revisa-master-express
- **AI Workflow Workshop**: a 12-hour hands-on workshop where Legal, Corporate, SALT
  and Tax Transformation teams mapped real work before designing agents, prompts,
  prototypes and solution specs.
  https://leonardosa.pro/solutions/ai-opportunity-mapping
- **Garden São Paulo: Commercial Workflow and CRM** (MasterTech): connected a landscaping
  company's commercial journey into one custom CRM with invoicing and AI-agent access
  via MCP. Every lead captured; ~70% less repetitive admin work (CEO's estimate).
  https://leonardosa.pro/solutions/garden-commercial-workflow
- **KBSE — Knowledge Base Search Engine** (team project; Python, Django, CrewAI, ChromaDB,
  Azure OpenAI): a RAG search engine for legal and regulatory questions, built in 2024.
  Every answer links to its original source. 94% validated accuracy and 99% user-rated
  relevance, measured with Legal and Corporate teams over ~3 months.
  https://leonardosa.pro/solutions/knowledge-base-search-engine
- **Saving Time App**: an app for Revisa Master consultants. AI turns audio notes into
  session summaries and next steps, then updates the client record.
  https://leonardosa.pro/solutions/saving-time-app
- **Lei do Bem Form Analysis**: MVP review assistant for R&D tax-incentive forms.
  Checked descriptions against Ministry standards while keeping consultants in the loop;
  saved roughly three hours per form.
  https://leonardosa.pro/solutions/lei-do-bem-form-analysis
